fields.statement: QA at 55bf2f1d0: cross-compiled the real rhiza binary for linux/darwin x amd64/arm64 with the .goreleaser.yaml ldflags, packed rhiza_0.1.0_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz per its name_template, wrote checksums.txt with sha256sum, then ran release.yml's step `go run ./tools/release -dist dist -tag v0.1.0 -commit <sha> -repo dphaener/rhiza`: exit 0, dist/manifest.json has channel=release, version=v0.1.0, the full commit, and 4 platforms sorted by os/arch, each URL https://github.com/dphaener/rhiza/releases/download/v0.1.0/<archive> and sha256 equal to checksums.txt; the extracted linux_amd64 binary prints `rhiza v0.1.0`. Re-ran the release-snapshot job's new step on a GoReleaser-shaped snapshot dist (metadata.json version 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT-55bf2f1): exit 0 and the jq length check = 4; with darwin_arm64 removed it fails ('missing platforms: darwin/arm64'), with a tampered archive it fails (sha256 mismatch), without -tag it fails. go test -count=1 -trimpath ./internal/release/... ./tools/release/... passes; gofmt and vet clean. GoReleaser itself not run (not installed here; PR CI runs it).

QA at 55bf2f1d0: parsed .github/workflows/release.yml with yaml.safe_load: permissions are contents/id-token/attestations all write; steps are checkout, Set up Go, Run GoReleaser (release --clean), Attest build provenance (actions/attest-build-provenance@v3, subject-path dist/*.tar.gz), Publish the channel manifest. gh api confirms the actions/attest-build-provenance v3 tag exists. The glob dist/*.tar.gz matches exactly the four archives the manifest step produced in a GoReleaser-shaped dist built from real cross-compiled binaries. release-snapshot.yml parses and its path filter covers release.yml, internal/release and tools/release, so goreleaser check and the snapshot run on the PR. Not run: goreleaser (not installed) and a real attestation (needs a v* tag; the orchestrator verifies it after cutting v0.1.0 per orchestrator-cuts-v010).
